ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent that automatically rebalances user liquidity across high-yield DeFi pools on Base using flash loans and decentralized vaults.
ideas.problem_statement: DeFi yield fragmentation and high manual gas overhead for liquidity providers.
ideas.title: YieldOptimizer Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines autonomous agents with DeFi protocols, mirroring the architecture of past winning agents and leveraging the core DeFi track.

ideas.pitch: A milestone-based public goods funding platform using smart contract streaming to release grant money only when verifiable GitHub milestones or deliverables are met.
ideas.problem_statement: Lack of transparent, outcome-driven funding allocation for open-source public goods.
ideas.title: ImpactStream
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Public Goods track with a practical business-oriented solution that appeals to DAO judges wanting accountability.

ideas.pitch: A self-custodial credential and credit scoring protocol backed by decentralized identity standards for undercollateralized micro-loans.
ideas.problem_statement: Underprivileged students and entrepreneurs lack traditional credit histories to access decentralized finance.
ideas.title: CredPass Identity
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the Open Innovation track while incorporating winning credit and self-custodial patterns from recent major hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An escrow-as-a-service platform tailored for decentralized freelance gig economies with multi-signature dispute resolution.
ideas.problem_statement: Trust and payment security issues in peer-to-peer decentralized freelance and service arrangements.
ideas.title: Aura Escrow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Emphasizes the business-oriented entrepreneurial requirement of DeFy'27 by solving a real invoicing and payment friction point.

ideas.pitch: A zero-knowledge proof verification pipeline that allows public goods donors to prove fund allocation compliance without exposing sensitive recipient metadata.
ideas.problem_statement: Privacy leaks and bureaucratic auditing overhead in decentralized public goods grant distribution.
ideas.title: ZeroGrant ZK-Verifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Introduces hard engineering through ZK circuits which strongly stands out in the Public goods track.
